verdict.rationale: mise is a local, open-source CLI for dev tools, environment variables and tasks. It is not an AI service and does not collect user data, so an opt-out from AI model training is a category error for this kind of product. Its MCP server only exposes project information to an external AI assistant; it does not make mise a model-training data processor.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
